name: game-unsaved-edits
goal: Keep unsaved authored game edits and generated image references when navigation is canceled

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Navigating away from a dirty real game loses title edits and generated image references; canceled navigation and reload must keep the document.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard game-authoring saved-graph and native creation matrix saved before navigating. Extend their shared lifecycle to cancel back-navigation and reload while dirty, including after image generation.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red record at 993ceb6af: the existing saved-graph flow cannot observe a discard confirmation and loses the edited document.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Guard dirty real game navigation with SvelteKit beforeNavigate; canceling either the app confirmation or native unload prompt keeps the document mounted.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable paired proof 993ceb6af to 7ab19e6bd preserves the same tests and environment: dirty navigation and reload can be canceled, saved data reopens, and historical edits remain blocked.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
